steps.content: The pickup truck rushes forward as fast as it can, almost falling apart from the rocky bumps on the road.
Chasing close behind is a large swarm of Mantises.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: I haven't been this popular for a long time. Hold on, we're almost there!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Didn't you just say you knew a lot about them? Why are we still being chased like this!!

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: It's all different under the Illusory Moon!

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Ouch!

After the pickup truck goes over the last ditch of its life and crashes heavily into a rock, it breaks down completely. Mantis is the first one to get back up. She grabs all the cartridges and kicks open the car door.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: You guys stay in the car. I'll lure them away!

The bullets had run out long ago. The naturalist only realizes this when she pulls the trigger of the empty gun. All she could do is turn the gun around and use it as a bat. She then tosses a homemade bug repellent smoke bomb near the car door and runs out of the smoke, leading the bugs away from you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mantis——!

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Don't make a sound! Protect Dreya, and wait for your companions to come! I'll be fine!
Before she can finish her sentence, a Mutant Bug knocks her aside. She can barely block its sharp claws with her firearm.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: No! I have my own companions. I need to go back somewhere else! As for you guys...
The swarm of bugs lets out an indistinguishable, terrifying shriek. "Mantis," however, seems to understand and starts yelling back at them.

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Take a good look at what you're doing! Would humans treat their own kind like this?!

She drops the firearm that had been holding off the creature and finds something to thrust in its face. The bug lets out a shrill screech, pushing "Mantis" away and convulsing in the sky with trembling wings.
In that moment, she also seems stunned. But more Mutant Bugs are rushing at her, and this time, "Mantis" has no strength left to fight back. You must help her!
The shackles are successfully released, but you can't see the result.
A dazzling white light suddenly engulfs everything, followed by the sound of bullets, shouts, and fierce resistance from the bugs.
Soon, the light dims. A few Mutant Bugs twitch on the ground, while many more have been forced to keep their distance.
Three people in protective suits stand in front of "Mantis," guarding against the sky with crude weapons. Only after confirming the bugs have left do they turn their heads to curse at "Mantis."

steps.speaker: Armed Person
steps.content: Didn't we say we were going to find help? Why did you run out here? Are you trying to scare us to death? If you keep this up, I'm really going to knock you out and lock you in the car!

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: Ahaha, I knew you guys would come for me...

steps.speaker: Mantis
steps.content: It's so good to have you guys here...
You help Dreya out of the smoke, and someone immediately comes over to you. Are they teammates of "Mantis"'? Are they... humans?
"Mantis" sits paralyzed on the ground. The naturalist gasps for breath, staring at the motionless Mutant Bug remains nearby with a mixed expression.
The "magic weapon" in her hands that scared off the Mutant Bugs a few minutes ago is just an ordinary mirror.
